cases.name: rich
cases.covers: Every distinction the read has to make: an absent key, a present-but-empty one, a UTF-16 title outside Latin-1, custom keys including an empty one, and dates in both the offset and the Z forms.

cases.name: report
cases.covers: A real document, whose Info dictionary is whatever its producer wrote.

cases.name: colors
cases.covers: A minimal document with almost no metadata: the mostly-absent case.

cases.name: document-actions
cases.covers: Every catalog action slot: a two-entry JavaScript name tree in boot order, an /OpenAction in its action form, and all five additional events. Nothing else in the repository has any of them.

cases.name: rotated
cases.covers: Four pages at /Rotate 0, 90, 180 and 270. The listing reports the rotation and the NORMALIZED size, so a reader using the rotated size would disagree with the page a caller then opens.

cases.name: page-actions
cases.covers: A page carrying open and close actions: a JavaScript node chaining to a URI through /Next, and a GoTo with an explicit /XYZ destination. PageLayout.actions was absent on both sides until this existed, so a comparison could not tell an unread action from a missing one.

cases.name: encrypted
cases.covers: Metadata behind encryption, which is read through the same path once unlocked.
